caption: The drawing features a single object resembling a stylized animal figure, possibly a lion or similar creature, depicted in profile facing to the right. The object has a head with prominent features such as pointed ears, a large open mouth showing teeth, a prominent nose, and expressive eyes. The neck and upper chest area have distinct curves and shapes, flowing downward to create a mane-like effect with arched, layered sections. The body below the head and neck displays a pattern resembling fish scales. The base of the figure is rounded, giving the whole object a vertical orientation. The colors used are predominantly light brown and gray, with some greenish and bluish tones used for accent and shadow. The drawing is made on a plain, unadorned light beige or off-white background, and there are no additional objects or scenery present. The artist's name, "HARRY KING," is written in the lower right corner.
title: Head of a Leopard
